result.title: Denoised but Not Improved: What EEG Denoising Does to a Downstream Task
result.comment: Accepted at the IEEE Symposium on CI in Health and Medicine
result.summary: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is routinely denoised before it reaches a downstream model, and the denoising literature scores a method by how closely its output matches a clean reference waveform. That reference does not exist for real scalp recordings: it is synthesized by adding artifact templates to signals merely presumed clean, and even an exact separation would return cortical activity blurred by volume conduction rather than the activity itself. Fidelity to it is therefore an unvalidatable objective, and whether it predicts any downstream benefit has gone largely unexamined. We report an audit that examines it. Holding a seizure-detection pipeline fixed and varying only the preprocessing stage, we find that five standard denoising methods, spanning analytic, cross-channel and supervised deep families, all fail to improve on the unprocessed signal, and most degrade it. To say what such a stage must instead do, we formalize a label-only, classifier-free probe that reads it by the separability geometry it induces on task-relevant features, decomposing any change into a between-class distance and a within-class scatter term. On a transform that does improve the task, the probe attributes the entire gain to a roughly one-quarter reduction of within-class scatter, with class separation statistically unchanged. What a downstream model benefits from is therefore variance suppression on task-relevant structure, which waveform-fidelity metrics neither measure nor reward.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计 EEG 去噪对下游癫痫检测的影响：固定检测流程、仅替换预处理，发现五种标准去噪方法均未优于未处理信号，多数反而更差；并提出一个仅用标签、无需分类器的探针，按任务相关特征的可分性几何把变化分解为类间距离与类内离散度，发现有效变换的收益几乎全部来自类内方差约四分之一的下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「波形保真度不预测下游收益，应按任务相关可分性评价中间表示」的思路，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉 latent 的保真度指标与推理收益脱节、以及证据筛选阶段的价值度量提供类比线索。
